title: Anointed Queens - Custom Bag House launch
notes: Launch: full storefront with design-your-own bag configurator
Shop: catalog with search, filters, sort, product detail with options and verified-buyer reviews
Escrow: every custom bag starts with a 50% deposit; balance invoiced and held on fulfilment until the client confirms
Loyalty, referrals and wishlists on every account
Admin portal: products, orders and escrow ops, custom-request queue, reviews moderation, customers, wallet, configurator options, journal and gallery
PWA installable, SEO-ready pages, gold and black luxury design system
Demo mode runs fully in the browser; Supabase wiring is a one-file switch (see supabase/SETUP.md)

1.1.0: viewable & shareable everywhere - cross-browser/device hardening (compat shim + CSS @supports fallbacks), share widget on every page (WhatsApp / X / Facebook / LinkedIn / Telegram / Email / native share / QR), per-page social previews and canonical URLs; validated on Chrome and Edge across desktop/tablet/mobile/narrow
